author: BernieSanders
text:
Trump is the most dangerous president in our history.

He's an authoritarian who does not believe in the rule of law.

This election is not about Ds vs. Rs.

It's about whether we maintain a rubber-stamp GOP Congress that aids and abets Trump — or finally hold him accountable.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Why are Elon Musk and other billionaires flooding the airwaves with Islamophobic ads against Abdul?

Because they have nothing to say about the issues that matter to working people: healthcare, climate, AI and foreign policy.

WE WILL NOT LET THEM DIVIDE US

author: BernieSanders
text:
AIPAC is spending $9 million in Michigan to elect Mike Rogers.

Meanwhile, according to a Washington Post poll, a majority of voters there — including 61% of independents — want to end or reduce military aid to Israel.

LET'S ELECT ABDUL AND END ALL MILITARY AID TO ISRAEL

author: BernieSanders
text:
Billionaires in California are spending $333 million to wage a war.

Against what?

Homelessness? No.
Cancer? No.
Child poverty? No.

They’re waging war against a 5% billionaire wealth tax.

They’d rather poor kids with cancer die than pay a little more in taxes. That is obscene.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Since Trump’s election:

-Musk got $680 billion richer
-Musk became the 1st trillionaire
-SpaceX got $10 billion in federal contracts
-Tesla & SpaceX paid $0 in federal income taxes

Now, Musk’s spending $442 million to keep Republicans in control of Congress.

Gee, I wonder why?

author: BernieSanders
text:
Young people will live longest with the consequences of AI, climate change and our broken political system. They deserve a voice in shaping their future.

Today I’m in Ann Arbor with Abdul-El Sayed talking to college students about how we fight back. x.com/i/broadcasts/1OxwbnXyp…

author: BernieSanders
text:
Wow. What a turnout. In a town of 10,000, in a county Trump won by almost 30 points, nearly 1,000 came out in support of Abdul El-Sayed.

Alpena, MI, thanks very much.

author: BernieSanders
text: Today I’m in the town of Alpena, Michigan, to talk to working people about why Abdul El-Sayed should be the next Senator from Michigan. x.com/i/broadcasts/1AKEmvgdz…

author: BernieSanders
text:
The billionaires may have unlimited amounts of money, but we have something far more powerful. We have the people.

I'll be in Ann Arbor tonight with @AbdulElSayed for the Students vs. Billionaires Town Hall. Join us to fight for a government that works for all, not just the 1%.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Thank you Grand Rapids!

When we send Abdul El-Sayed to the U.S. Senate, we are going to send a profound message:

NO to hatred, bigotry and diviseness 
NO to oligarchy
NO to authoritarianism

Let’s get it done.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Congratulations to Lula on his extraordinary reelection victory in the Brazilian presidential election.

Lula has stood up for Brazilian workers & democracy — and will continue to do so in the next four years.

author: BernieSanders
text:
AIPAC, crypto, and the AI industry are spending tens of millions against Abdul El-Sayed because he believes our government should work for working people, not billionaires.

Today in Grand Rapids, we're fighting for a Michigan that puts people first. x.com/i/broadcasts/1yKAPwLoV…

text:

I asked the crowd how many of them would like a data center in their community. This was their response.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Rebecca Cooke is the daughter of farmers, a waitress and a small business owner. She knows what working people are up against because she's lived it.  
Wisconsin's 3rd District needs a representative who understands working families, not corporate lobbyists.

x.com/i/broadcasts/1kKzDPYWy…

author: BernieSanders
text:
Trump just said the quiet part out loud:

He doesn’t “give a damn” about higher gas prices, as long as his billionaire friends are making a fortune.

Trump doesn’t tell the truth very often, but he did last night!

author: BernieSanders
text:
Thank you Duluth, Minnesota! Great crowd.

Let’s reelect Keith Ellison as Attorney General and send Peggy Flanagan to the United States Senate.

author: BernieSanders
text:
The billionaire class can pour millions into elections, but they cannot buy the support of the people. Peggy Flanagan has shown that.

Today in Duluth, we're getting out the vote with Peggy and Keith Ellison to keep Minnesota fighting for working families. x.com/i/broadcasts/1XxygwqPO…

author: BernieSanders
text:
President Obama is right. Angie Nixon will make a great U.S. Senator.

She has overcome enormous odds. She has the momentum.

She’s gonna win!

author: BernieSanders
text:
Trump is trying to block certification of Alaska's Senate election if the Republican loses.

This is his authoritarianism in real time.

This is why we must do everything we can to win this election, defend democracy and create a government that works for all, not just the 1%.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Elon Musk and his fellow billionaires think they can buy our democracy. 

They are wrong. Together, we will defeat oligarchy.

author: BernieSanders
BernieSanders
text:

We must fight back. My congressional colleagues and I have donated $1.4M to combat AIPAC’s spending, but Abdul needs more.

text:
Mark Zuckerberg’s threat to leave CA if voters approve a 5% billionaire wealth tax was a bluff.

He’s not alone. Since Prop 40 was filed, CA gained 32 billionaires & billionaires in CA got $381 billion richer.

Yes. It’s time for a billionaire wealth tax. It starts in California.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Will we continue to have a rubber-stamp Republican Senate for Trump and his billionaire pals? 

Or will we elect leaders like Abdul El-Sayed who will take on the oligarchs and fight for working families? 

MICHIGAN: Join me on Sunday and Monday to get out the vote for Abdul.

author: BernieSanders
text:
No. I’m not “scapegoating” AIPAC.

You support Trump's illegal war in Iran. Americans don’t.

You want taxpayers to spend billions funding the Israeli government. Americans don’t.

Your super PAC is spending $9 million to defeat Abdul because he opposes your agenda. Unacceptable.

author: BernieSanders
text:
AIPAC is now spending as much as $9 million against Abdul El-Sayed.

AIPAC is why we’re at war in Iran.

AIPAC is why the U.S. has supported genocide in Gaza.

We must say NO to AIPAC.

YES to electing Abdul as Michigan’s next U.S. Senator.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Yesterday, I was proud to join more than 600 University of Houston-Downtown students who marched to the polls and stood up to Republican voter suppression. 

They are opposing authoritarianism and fighting for democracy. 

That’s exactly what we have got to do all over America.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Unbelievable. The most corrupt president in U.S. history created a “fraud whistleblower program.”

Ok. Let’s blow the whistle. Trump has:

Illegally accepted a $400 million plane from Qatar

Got $1.4 billion richer from crypto scams

Used taxpayer money for TV ads

That’s fraud!

author: BernieSanders
text:
Musk's super PACs have now spent over $400 million to buy the midterm elections.

This campaign is not just about Democrats vs. Republicans.

It’s about whether the world’s first trillionaire can buy our government.

Say NO to Musk. Say NO to oligarchy. Say yes to democracy.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Join me this Sunday in Eau Claire, Wisconsin, for a rally with Rebecca Cooke.

Rebecca is a working-class fighter who will take on corporate monopolies, raise the minimum wage and stand up to the billionaire class. We need more fighters like Rebecca in Congress.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Duluth, Minnesota, let’s get out the vote!

Join me, Peggy Flanagan and Keith Ellison this Saturday for a rally to defeat the oligarchs, stand up for working people, and build a government that works for all of us.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Thank you to the packed house in Houston, Texas. 

We’re going to win Texas. 

We’re going to win back Congress. 

We’re going to finally hold Trump and the oligarchs accountable.

Let’s get it done.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Texas can make the difference as to whether the Senate remains a Republican rubber-stamp for Trump or whether we finally hold him accountable.

Together, we must do everything we can to stop the most dangerous president in history. x.com/i/broadcasts/1RKZzBdjp…

author: BernieSanders
text:
At a time when Republican officials in Texas are attempting to suppress the vote, these young students at University of Houston-Downtown are standing up for democracy and are on their way to march to the polls.

Proud to join them today.

author: BernieSanders
text:
A new poll says 70% of Americans doubt that Trump will accept the election results if Republicans lose in November.

Too many Americans fought and died for democracy.

Trump’s authoritarianism will not prevail.

Go vote. We WILL win this election whether Trump likes it or not.

author: BernieSanders
text:
"We have to drive six hours to Dallas, or nine hours to Austin, just to get the medical care that my children need every single month."

Listen to the story of a single mother with two young kids who attended our event in Amarillo, Texas.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Thanks El Paso, Texas, for a great event and a great turnout. 

Oligarchic greed is destroying our economy.  

The rich get richer while working families struggle. 

Let’s end Republican control of Congress and create an economy that works for all, not just the few.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Over the past 2 years, Texans have watched in horror as Trump's domestic army, ICE, destroyed millions of Americans' lives. Enough!
 
We must hold Republicans accountable for their disastrous policies. x.com/i/broadcasts/1nJOLQyqP…

author: BernieSanders
text:
No surprise. Trump just endorsed Netanyahu.

Together, they want never-ending war in the Middle East. More death. More destruction. More genocide.

On November 3, we must end Republican control of Congress.

We must stop all military aid to Israel.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Great town meeting in Amarillo, Texas. The stress that working families experience is a crisis. 

It’s not just adults. Kids are hurting, too.

author: BernieSanders
text:
On our way to Texas for Fighting Oligarchy rallies in Amarillo, El Paso and Houston.

Musk is spending $190 million to try to buy the U.S. Senate election here.  

Thanks Elon for making it clear to Texans exactly what oligarchy is.

author: BernieSanders
text:
When Trump says, “Jump!” Mike Rogers says, “How high?”

We cannot allow Republicans to continue to control the Senate and rubber-stamp Trump’s disastrous policies.

STOP TRUMP. VOTE ABDUL EL-SAYED.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Thank you, Florida! Four great events and great turnouts. 

Florida is catching @AngieNixon fever. She’s going to win.

author: BernieSanders
text:
They say Florida is a red state, but you know what I'm hearing?

Working people everywhere are sick & tired of the same old politics and policies. They want real change.

Watch LIVE as I rally in Tallahassee with Angie Nixon. x.com/i/broadcasts/1yxBePnBv…

author: BernieSanders
text:
When Sergey Brin, the 4th richest man alive, isn’t dining with Trump, what’s he doing?

He’s spending $138 million against California’s 5% billionaire wealth tax.

He’d rather working class kids die because they can’t afford healthcare than pay his fair share in taxes. Obscene.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Incredible event in Gainesville today. More than 2,800 people turned out — 2,000 outside in the overflow. 

The oligarchs got the money. We’ve got the people. 

Watch out Washington, D.C. Angie Nixon is coming.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Vikki Goodwin understands that healthcare is a right, not a privilege, and her Texas Cares Plan would expand healthcare to millions of Texans who have been left behind.

I am proud to endorse Vikki Goodwin for Texas Lieutenant Governor.

author: BernieSanders
text:
As a union organizer, state legislator & small business owner, Angie Nixon has seen too many Floridians work hard but struggle to get by.

That's why she'll fight for affordable housing, free childcare & Medicare for All. x.com/i/broadcasts/1kKzDPjnw…

author: BernieSanders
text:
There are more than 700 people in line for our rally in Gainesville. It starts in a hour and a half. 

Florida is fired up for Angie.

text:
Wow. 1,800 people in Melbourne where Trump won 60% of the county’s vote in 2024. 

Americans — Democrats, Republicans, and Independents — are sick and tired of a corrupt and broken political and economic system.

They’re ready to elect leaders like Angie Nixon to the U.S. Senate.

author: BernieSanders
text: Voters are looking for candidates who will take on the greed of the billionaire class and FIGHT. Angie Nixon is one of those leaders. x.com/i/broadcasts/1pKdRDkyP…

text:
The Republican-controlled board of elections shut down the 1 early voting site at North Carolina A&T University—a historically Black college—so students marched an hour to vote.

CONGRATULATIONS TO THESE STUDENTS FOR FIGHTING BACK. WE MUST ALL DO THE SAME.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Great crowd in Tampa. Thank you to everyone who came out in the rain. 

Somebody told me that Florida is a red state. It does not look like one today. 

Together, we can take on Trump and the billionaire class and elect Angie Nixon to the Senate.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Angie Nixon was outspent 16 to 1 in the Dem primary. But she stood with working people and won a HUGE upset.

We need leaders like Angie in the Senate. x.com/i/broadcasts/1pJdRDkaY…

text:

NO to authoritarianism

NO to oligarchy

NO to a rigged economy

NO to Kings

Our job: Educate. Organize. Get your friends to vote.

text:
This election is not just Democrats vs. Republicans. It’s about Musk and other oligarchs buying our government, undermining democracy and making themselves even richer with Trump’s anti-worker policies.

text:
After spending $290 million to elect Trump in 2024, Elon Musk is now spending $369 million to keep Republicans in control of Congress.

Vote NO on Musk, YES for democracy.

Stop Musk and Republicans from maintaining their rubber-stamp Congress for Trump’s disastrous policies.

text:
This is what corruption is all about:

Last year Trump gave $1 trillion in tax breaks to the top 1%.

Now his billionaire pals are returning the favor by giving him $330 million for his fancy ballroom.

We don’t want a government of, by and for the billionaire class. FIGHT BACK.

author: BernieSanders
text:
We can no longer tolerate a rigged economy that has enabled one man to become a trillionaire while the U.S. minimum wage has been stuck at $7.25/hour for 17 years.

When Democrats regain control of Congress we must raise the minimum wage to at least $20 an hour.

No more excuses.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Trump wants you to “pretend he’s on the ballot.”

So, remember.

A vote for a Republican is a vote for:

-The Iran War
-$4.23 gas in MN
-$6 heating oil in ME
-$6.49 diesel in MI
-$1,000 a month groceries in FL
-$1,800 a month premiums in IA
-$1 trillion in tax breaks to the 1%

author: BernieSanders
text:
If we want to end billionaire control of our government, stop Trump’s illegal war in Iran, lower gas prices and guarantee healthcare as a human right, we must end Republican control of Congress.

Join me in Texas next week for get-out-the-vote rallies across the state.

author: BernieSanders
text:
The top 1% owns more wealth than the bottom 93%.

1 man owns more wealth than the bottom 53% of households.

Less than a thousand billionaires got $2.2 trillion richer in the last year.

Obscene.

Yes. We need a 5% billionaire wealth tax in California and throughout America.

author: BernieSanders
text:
If you want to open a sandwich shop, food inspectors must first determine that it’s safe.

If you’re a Big Tech Oligarch who builds an AI product that could threaten the human race? That product won’t be subject to 1 safety regulation.

That’s insane. We must regulate AI — NOW!

author: BernieSanders
text:
Thank you Abdul El-Sayed for putting out a bold plan to protect the American people against the very serious dangers posed by advanced AI & superintelligence.

I look forward to working with you to pass it.

We won’t allow Big Tech Oligarchs to determine the future of humanity.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Trump endorsed Michele Tafoya for MN Senate.

Of course he wants to keep a rubber-stamp GOP Senate.

STOP TRUMP. VOTE PEGGY FLANAGAN.

text:
What a corrupt campaign finance system looks like:

Between 2024 and 2026, Musk spent over $650 million to buy elections.
Crypto spent over $500 million
AIPAC spent $230 million
AI spent over $200 million

Dems must implement REAL campaign finance reform. ONE PERSON, ONE VOTE.

author: BernieSanders
text:
The crises facing our country are too serious for status quo politics and status quo policies. 

That’s why we need leaders like Angie Nixon who aren’t afraid to take on the billionaire class and deliver for working families.

I hope you’ll join us in Florida this weekend.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Trump is an authoritarian.

He wants to intimidate his political opponents, the media and all those who disagree with him.

Ilhan Omar came to America legally as a child refugee fleeing civil war, became a citizen and was elected to Congress.

Trump is weaponizing the federal government to silence opposition. Fight back. Defend democracy.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Elon Musk spent $290 million to elect Trump. It paid off.

Since his election, Musk got $696 billion richer & became the world’s 1st trillionaire.

But that’s not enough.

Now, Musk is spending $366 million to keep Republicans in control of Congress.

STOP MUSK. STOP OLIGARCHY.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Donald Trump is corrupt.

He is a narcissist.

He is a pathological liar.

He is a danger to the United States and to working families.

We cannot allow his party to control the Senate. VOTE.

text:

author: BernieSanders
text:

text:
On our way to Lewiston, Maine for a noon rally with Troy Jackson.

EVERY STATE COUNTS.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Thank you, Bangor, Maine.

Together, we are going to take back the Senate from Republicans and elect working-class champions like Troy Jackson.

author: BernieSanders
text:

text:
Like those who opposed JFK in 1960 because he was Catholic…

Like those who opposed Obama in 2008 because he was Black…

Republicans today are attacking Abdul El-Sayed because he is Muslim.

Don’t let bigotry win. Fight back!

text:
If you or I called in a fake homicide tip, fraudulently applied for 20 visas and hacked websites, we’d be arrested and prosecuted.

The same standard must apply to AI CEOs.

Prosecute CEOs when their products break the law and pause advanced AI NOW.

author: BernieSanders
text:

ME can make the difference as to whether the Senate remains a GOP rubber stamp for Trump or whether we finally hold him accountable & represent working families. Let’s go Troy.

text:
Congratulations to UAW President Shawn Fain on his reelection. Shawn is one of the great union leaders in our country.  

He has taken on the billionaire class, won strong victories for his members and understands the need to organize, organize, organize.  

Solidarity forever!

author: BernieSanders
text: Why Abdul won last night's Michigan Senate debate.

author: BernieSanders
text:

He'll work with Iowans to put clean water front and center as the Iowa Secretary of Agriculture.

author: BernieSanders
text:
SAY NO TO TRUMP’S RACISM

Trump has a problem: THE AMERICAN PEOPLE ARE CATCHING ON TO HIS FAILED POLICIES.

* The cost of gas, housing and groceries are soaring.
* 15 million Americans will soon be thrown off the healthcare they have so that he could provide a trillion in tax breaks to the 1%.
* There is a grassroots rebellion against his desire to see AI unregulated and data centers proliferate in every state.
* His unconstitutional and illegal war in Iran is increasingly unpopular.

So. What do you do when you have no rational solutions to the crises we face? You go to the demagogue’s playbook of spreading racism and hatred.

No, Mr. President.  Abdul El-Sayed is not “a RADICAL Extremist, Terrorist Sympathizer.” He is a medical doctor who wants to guarantee healthcare for all, raise wag…

author: BernieSanders
text:
In 2010, billionaires spent $32 million to influence the mid-term elections.

Today, 170 billionaire families have spent a record $1.7 billion on the 2026 midterms. Insane.

Democracy must be 1 person, 1 vote — not billionaires buying elections.

We must end Citizens United-NOW.

text:

If you paid $1 in income taxes in 2019, 2020 or 2023, you paid more than Larry Page & Sergey Brin, Google’s co-founders, who became $400 billion richer since 2019.

Now, Brin is spending $138 million to oppose a 5% billionaire wealth tax in CA.

Disgusting.

author: BernieSanders
text:

Neither are the 19 American troops and 3,000+ Iranians who lost their lives.

Our president is unhinged.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Thank you Los Angeles for a packed house tonight for Proposition 40, the California wealth tax.

The American people are sick and tired of massive income and wealth inequality.

Billionaires need to start paying their fair share.

author: BernieSanders
text:

text:

That’s obscene.
 
Let’s win on Prop 40.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Great event tonight in Bakersfield — a strong working class community. 

The people here deserve a leader in Congress who will fight back against Trump’s disastrous policies.

Randy Villegas is that leader.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Randy Villegas grew up in a working-class family. He's an educator, a small business owner, and he'll fight in Congress for working-class Americans — not for the billionaires.

text:

text:

text:

text:

text:

text:

text:

text:

text:
It looks like the Republican establishment and their billionaire backers are beginning to panic about Angie Nixon. And they should.  

She pulled off a huge upset in winning the Democratic primary and she’s going to do it again in the general election.

Go Angie!

text:
